title: Realtor: broker identity candidates held from contact delivery
hypothesis: An active real-estate register can establish a broker or designated-broker identity candidate, but it cannot establish brokerage ownership, handset ownership, or a direct business contact. Candidates must be held until independently supported by a permitted public business-contact route and normal contact gates.
ownerSource: Active broker-company and broker records: TX TREC designated-broker links; FL DBPR independent BK rows; and equivalent state register roles. These are identity candidates, not owner-confirmed people.
phoneSource: No eligible contact source is implemented for this review. Catalogue register fields are identity-only or lack a phone; do not use licence or property addresses to obtain private contact data.

workflow.label: State legal gate
workflow.detail: Permit only an eligible public register route; SC and UT list sources are held as prohibited.

workflow.label: Hold restricted state
workflow.detail: Do not ingest a prohibited commercial-list source or replace it with a private lookup.

workflow.label: Active broker register
workflow.detail: Read an active broker company, independent broker, or explicitly eligible managing-broker record.

workflow.label: Role evidence assessment
workflow.detail: Preserve designated broker, independent broker, or managing broker; reject sales associates and unsupported entity-only rows.

workflow.label: Hold insufficient identity
workflow.detail: Inactive, employee, sales-associate, entity-only, and ambiguous rows are not owner candidates.

workflow.label: Public business match
workflow.detail: Require exact business identity evidence where a permitted public business-contact source exists; city-only and name-only matches are held.

workflow.label: Hold unmatched business
workflow.detail: Do not turn a licence or residential address into a personal-contact lookup.

workflow.label: Permitted business contact available?
workflow.detail: A public business contact requires independent owner evidence before it can be treated as direct to the candidate.

workflow.label: Hold contact candidate
workflow.detail: No safe contact path is wired; do not parcel-match, trace, append, or deliver.

workflow.label: Future contact gates
workflow.detail: A separately authorized route would require contact type, live, DNC, suppression, dedupe, and owner-evidence gates.

workflow.label: Deliver supported classification
workflow.detail: Only deliver after every permitted contact and ownership gate passes.

failures.risk: A designated broker is treated as the brokerage owner.
failures.mitigation: Retain the exact licence role and require independent ownership evidence.

failures.risk: Sales associates, managing brokers, and independent brokers are treated as equivalent.
failures.mitigation: Scope active licence types and preserve source role codes before candidate classification.

failures.risk: A licence address, especially FL BK address, proceeds to residential parcel lookup or skip tracing.
failures.mitigation: Hold Realtor recipe-B rows before parcel and trace stages until a permitted public business-contact route exists.

failures.risk: A public listing phone is labelled a direct broker mobile.
failures.mitigation: Treat it only as a business-contact candidate pending independent owner and contact evidence.

failures.risk: SC or UT restricted licence lists enter a generic Realtor path.
failures.mitigation: Apply the state legal gate and retain prohibited-state rows in hold.

iterations.hypothesis: A Realtor register route can produce owner-contact candidates from broker records.
iterations.test: Free aggregate-only query of five active TX TREC Broker Company records on 2026-09-24, requesting licence type, status, company name, designated-broker field, and original licence date.
iterations.observed: 5/5 selected rows had all requested identity/linkage fields. The source observation contained no phone measurement and did not establish ownership or contact truth.
iterations.change: Use broker-company linkage only as identity-candidate evidence; hold Realtor jobs before any residential parcel or trace step.

measurement.result: TX TREC s7ft-44qi: five active Broker Company records had licence type, status, company-name, designated-broker, and original-licence-date fields present. Aggregate-only field-coverage observation; no values retained. It does not measure ownership, phone, mobile status, reachability, DNC, or delivery.

cost.note: No clean owner contact was observed. The live brain's historical rate is a different paid-step denominator and is not a per-clean cost for this review.

implementation.summary: Realtor register adapters and recipe-B mappings are wired, but recipe B proceeds through residential parcel lookup and paid skip tracing. No safe public-business-contact path, ownership classifier, or Realtor-specific hold exists.

nextMeasurement: Run five synthetic Realtor cases—active TX broker company, inactive company, sales associate, FL independent BK with a street, and SC/UT restricted state—and assert every retained candidate holds before parcel or trace. A separately authorized public business-contact test must measure business-match, candidate-contact, and gate outcomes with separate denominators.
